title: Incredible Adventures
specs: Children under 2 years of age must ride in a rear-facing car seat.
Children under the age of 8 must be secured in a car seat or booster seat in the back seat.
Our redwood tours from San Francisco are just a quick 30 minutes from downtown, so before long you’ll see the trees of Muir Woods that are between 800 and 1,200 years old.
Experience the awe-inspiring sights, where you’ll hike, swim, and meander through many of the park’s most famous outlooks and tranquil spaces.

Travelers must be fully prepared to handle all logistics within the park, including securing their own reservations for lodging (e.g., camping, hotels, or rental cabins) well in advance, as same-day availability is extremely rare.
You must collect your Alcatraz tickets at the ticket booth 45 minutes prior to your departure time. -Photo ID and Confirmation Email are required to pick up tickets.
You will also have free time alone to walk, hike, bike, swim and reflect on the beauty and grandeur of this natural wonder.
Sausalito Kayak Private Group Tour: minimum 4 guests per booking.
You will need your printed proof of purchase (voucher) and a photo ID to join the cruise.
San Francisco Seaplane Tours | Golden Gate Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.

services.name: Muir Woods and Sausalito Half-Day Tour
services.desc: Half-day guided tour to Muir Woods and Sausalito with time to walk among ancient coastal redwoods and explore Sausalito’s waterfront. Price includes all taxes and fees

services.name: Muir Woods Tour with Seaplane or Helicopter Adventure
services.desc: Tour to Muir Woods and Sausalito with time among ancient coastal redwoods, a narrated Sausalito visit, and a scenic seaplane or helicopter flight. Price includes all taxes and fees

services.name: Muir Woods and Point Reyes Hiking Tour
services.desc: Full-day guided day trip from San Francisco to Muir Woods, Point Reyes coastline, and a meadery tasting. Price includes all taxes and fees

services.desc: Guided bike tour across the Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito with a Muir Woods walk and return by shuttle or optional ferry. Price includes all taxes and fees

includes: Please follow the pick-up times and locations that have been provided to you by Incredible Adventures.
This day tour completes your trip to Northern California and includes a guided tour of Yosemite Valley with our professional guides.
Take a fantastic tour of beautiful San Francisco, and use the hop-on hop-off buses to catch a ride up to the pier for your Alcatraz cruise (included)!
During the cruise, frequent wildlife encounters include those with seagulls, pelicans, and sea lions.

faq.q: HOW FAR IS IT FROM SAN FRANCISCO TO YOSEMITE?
faq.a: A. The route we drive is generally about 192 miles (309 km) one-way, and takes 3-4 hours depending on traffic. We try to break up the long drive with stops at a local fruit stand to get some fresh produce, a stop for food/meals, and of course, bathroom breaks when needed.
